description_en: Retrieves information about all user groups in your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 批量查询当前阿里云账号下所有用户组的信息
name: ListUserGroups

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A collection of user group IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 用户组ID集合。最多可输入100个用户组ID
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the user group. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It supports both uppercase and lowercase letters and Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户组名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The value of a user group property. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户组属性的值。长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: attribute_value

parameters.help_en:
The ID of an internal network access policy. You can get this value from:

[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): List internal network access policies.

[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an internal network access policy
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略
parameters.name: pa_policy_id

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of user groups

Attributes.description_en: A collection of user group properties. Multiple properties are combined with OR logic
Attributes.description_zh: 用户组属性集合。多个用户组属性之间是或的关系，按照合集生效

IdpId.description_en: The identity provider ID for the user group. This parameter appears only when the user group type is department
IdpId.description_zh: 用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，存在该值

Relation.description_en:
The relation for the user group. Valid values:

Equal: Equal to.

Unequal: Not equal to
Relation.description_zh:
用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于

UserGroupType.description_en:
The type of the user group. Valid values:

username: Username.

department: Department.

email: Email address.

telephone: Phone number
UserGroupType.description_zh:
用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机

Value.description_en:
The value of the user group property.

If the user group type is username, this is the username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It supports both uppercase and lowercase letters and Chinese characters.

If the user group type is department, this is the department name. Example: OU=Department 1,OU=SASE DingTalk.

If the user group type is email, this is the email address. Example: username\@example.com.

If the user group type is telephone, this is the phone number. Example: 13900001234
Value.description_zh:
用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the user group was created

Description.description_en: A description of the user group

Name.description_en: The name of the user group

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the user group
